tbesh_html:
1) thorn(s), adamant, flint
1a) thorns, thorn-bushes
1b) adamant (as sharp)
1c) a sharp stone, flint
1c1) perhaps a diamond

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a thorn; also (from its keenness for scratching) a gem, probably the diamond
strongs_1890.derivation: from H8104 (שָׁמַר) in the original sense of pricking;
